description: Authoritative evidence-method vocabulary shared by the Python matrix engine and the Node probe runner. Rank orders evidence strength during merge. humanEvidence marks methods performed by a person, which the EARL renderer reports as manual mode. overwriteLocked marks methods a later automated result must never replace.

methods.name: manual-keyboard
methods.summary: A person operated the surface by keyboard and recorded what happened.

methods.name: screen-reader
methods.summary: A real assistive technology produced the observed announcement.

methods.name: cognitive-walkthrough
methods.summary: A person judged comprehension, wording, or task flow.

methods.name: runtime-automation
methods.summary: A browser-driven probe observed the rendered surface.

methods.name: axe-auto
methods.summary: An automated rule engine reported a violation or pass.

methods.name: static-source
methods.summary: Source inspection without executing the surface.

methods.name: plan-derived
methods.summary: Carried from a planning artifact rather than observed.
